name: 28328 · Clinton, NC
findings: ZIP 28328 (Clinton) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28328 (Clinton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28328 (Clinton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
